name: motion-clip-open
title: Image Clip Scrub
description: Ảnh đứng yên, khung nhìn mở rộng từ một khe hẹp giữa ảnh ra đủ khung, góc bo nhỏ dần, như mở cửa sổ.

moworks.author: moworks

options.insetY: % at the start, top and bottom (12)
options.closeAt: s after the start to close in 0.5 s (null)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: The picture stays fixed (240x136 in the demo); its clip-path inset goes from 12 % (top / bottom) and 42 % (left / right) to 0, corner radius 22 → 6 px, 1.2 s power2.inOut (easeInOutCubic). Optional close: the reverse in 0.5 s. The image itself does not scale or move. Small arrows at the side edges show the opening while it moves. Params: inset (12 % / 42 % → 0) · radius (22 → 6 px) · duration (1.2 s) · ease (power2.inOut).
moworks.titleVi: Ảnh mở cửa sổ từ khe hẹp
